name: alstonshi-portfolio
description: Alston Shi — photography portfolio. Source JSX precompiled to /dist for production.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && babel about.jsx app.jsx camera.jsx carousel.jsx chrome.jsx contact.jsx core.jsx data.jsx home.jsx portfolio.jsx tweaks-panel.jsx --out-dir dist --presets=@babel/preset-env,@babel/preset-react --no-comments --minified
scripts.build:dev: mkdir -p dist && babel about.jsx app.jsx camera.jsx carousel.jsx chrome.jsx contact.jsx core.jsx data.jsx home.jsx portfolio.jsx tweaks-panel.jsx --out-dir dist --presets=@babel/preset-env,@babel/preset-react
